Looking for a privacy-friendly note-taking app?

Joplin is a free, open-source, offline-first note-taking app that stores your notes in Markdown. Sync across devices with end-to-end encryption using Nextcloud, WebDAV, or your own Joplin Server.

Available on Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, and iOS, with plugins, themes, and browser web clippers.

More details & alternatives:
https://digitalescapetools.com/tools/joplin.html
